command: Dictyostelium discoideum statA participates in regulation of cell population proliferation (GO:0042127) and defense response (GO:0006952). Adjudicate each separately using the actual GO definitions, primary Dictyostelium evidence, and phylogenetic conservation. Distinguish proliferation from developmental differentiation and defense from a generic stress phenotype. Identify whether the gene product performs a mechanistic role in the process.
